title: Control software calibration release
engineering_question: A control calibration is being released. Which previously completed verification is invalidated and must be repeated?
one_liner: Determine whether this software release requires regression testing, and of what.
initial_input: Engineering change ECR-004 releases a control calibration revising the thermal derate map and torque ramp shaping to improve continuous power availability.
expected_reasoning_paths: TR-059 satisfies the ASIL D requirement REQ-052 but was executed on calibration INV-4.0.2, two revisions behind the proposed release, so the safety evidence is stale
Changing the derate map directly alters the behaviour verified by TEST-052, so that verification must be repeated
The thermal derate map is shared with the QI-001 thermal investigation, so this change interacts with an open investigation and could mask or worsen it
Range estimation TEST-112 already fails, and changing torque ramp shaping affects consumption, so REQ-113 evidence is also invalidated
known_unknowns: The specific calibration parameters changed between INV-4.1.7 and v4.2 are not enumerated in the environment
No HIL regression suite definition exists in the environment
Whether the derate map change has been coordinated with the QI-001 investigation team is not recorded
data_classification: SIMULATED ENTERPRISE ARTEFACT - not OEM, customer or proprietary data
